limitations: Host audit samples same-user process CPU/IO/RSS and all GPU compute PIDs every ~2 seconds, with whole-NVMe settling checks before each case; it cannot exclude every short OS event. CPU0 changes the intended prompt baseline, so band labels are descriptive. Diagnostic profiling adds CUDA events and synchronization. Every process runs three identical 16K/2K requests; the exit profiler includes the first warm-up and all subsequent prefill work. Stage event intervals are accumulated GPU stream time, may include stream stalls, and are not a pure kernel breakdown or a sum of end-to-end request wall time. Four fixed fresh starts are a bounded verification sample, not an unbiased frequency estimate or a clean speed/quality comparison. Output IDs can differ; no new numerical CHECK run.
